|sellprice = 500 |edibility = 10 }} The '''Golden Egg''' is an [[:Category:Animal Products|animal product]] obtained from [[Golden Chicken]]s. They will produce a Golden Egg every day as long as they are fed. To obtain Golden Eggs and Golden Chickens, [[Perfection]] must have been achieved. Progress can be tracked in [[Qi's Walnut Room#Perfection Tracker|Qi's Walnut Room]]. After reaching Perfection, the first Golden Egg can be obtained in four ways: *[[Marnie's Ranch]] for {{Price|100000}}. *[[Qi's Walnut Room]] for {{Price|100|gem}}. *[[Random Events#The Witch|Random Event]] that occurs after the player goes to sleep. A golden witch will fly over a [[Coop]] and leave a Golden Egg inside. *Randomly from a [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chest]] (0.12% chance). Golden Eggs can be put into an [[incubator]] in a [[Carpenter's Shop#Farm Buildings|Big or Deluxe Coop]] to hatch a Golden Chicken 6 days later, or 3 days with the [[Farming#Farming Skill|Coopmaster Profession]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |neutral=Robin,Maru,Caroline,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Emily,Elliott,Gus,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus,Leo |like=Demetrius,Linus,Pierre,Alex,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie |hate=Sebastian |dislike=Abigail,Pam,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Dwarf,Wizard }} ==Bundles== Golden Egg is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Artisan Goods== :''See also: [[Animal Products Profitability]]'' Golden Eggs can be used to make the following [[Artisan Goods]].
